title: Thinking on Leverage: What it Means and How you Do it
summary: Kahran and Divya pull the word 'leverage' apart from physics through finance to social life. Kahran explains what corporate leverage actually means (debt to equity, bonds, derivatives, 3x ETFs) while Divya frames leverage as how you treat the assets in your life — including a diverse portfolio of friendships that you don't over- or under-leverage. They cover how Archimedes's lever, COVID-era social networks, and personal finance all share the same shape.

intents.display: to think about leverage as a frame for money and relationships
